reason: 基于仓库说明与清单，该插件面向 Minecraft 开发场景，核心是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可调用的技能与工具来生成/配置项目骨架、执行构建，并通过内置子代理组织开发流程，因此主要用途是插件开发辅助而非通用内容服务。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 Minecraft 项目开发所需的知识技能、项目脚手架与构建执行能力，并支持按计划-骨架-内容-验证链路协助任务推进。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides Minecraft development skills, project scaffolding, and build execution, with an optional chain of planning, skeleton, content, and verification steps to help complete development tasks.

capabilities: Creates and updates files for Minecraft project scaffolds and metadata via `mc_scaffold`.
Executes Gradle tasks in a user-specified project directory via `mc_gradle`.
Provides built-in subagents for plan/skeleton/content/verify workflow steps.
May write preset files into the user preset directory when the plugin starts.

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds 7 Minecraft development skills and 2 tools (mc_scaffold, mc_gradle) for Paper/Spigot/Fabric/Forge/NeoForge workflows.
README documents a 4-subagent chain (plan/skeleton/content/verify) and behavior to auto-install/update preset files under `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/minecraft/`.
package.json exposes a DSH server plugin manifest and includes disclosed filesystem/perprocess permissions for mc_scaffold and mc_gradle.
